summary: v7.0.7 slash-symbol + market-whitelist regression PASS. Backend 41/41 (test_iter17_v707_slash_symbol_markets.py) confirms all 8 dashboard markets (crypto, etf, stock_id, stock_us, world_stocks, gold_silver, commodity, forex) return 200 with populated assets[] — previously forex/gold_silver crashed 500 with UnboundLocalError. Asset chart/track-record/news endpoints return 200 for every representative symbol including slash-encoded EUR-USD, GBP-USD, XAU-USD, XAG-USD (backend correctly decodes '-' → '/' for forex/gold_silver only) as well as commodity CORN/BRENT, world_stocks AAPL, and crypto BTC baseline. POST /api/asset/commodity/CORN/analyze and /api/asset/forex/EUR-USD/analyze return non-5xx (verified 200). Cross-market search: q=CORN → hits[0].market == 'commodity' (verified twice, first flaky attempt returned empty due to a transient Yahoo cold-start; second call returned CORN with market=commodity in <1s); q=EUR → at least one 'forex' hit; q=XAU → at least one 'gold_silver' hit. Chat: POST without entitlement correctly returns 403 (device not entitled); GET /api/chat/messages?limit=100 returns 200 with messages[] array (all messages within last 16h retention window). GET /api/ai/models returns 3 models. GET /api/subscription/health returns 200 with publisher_client_initialised present. Frontend (mobile web preview 390x844): header shows 'Ver 7.0.7' exactly; category chip row displays all 7 chips (Crypto, ETF, IDX Stocks, World Stocks, Gold/Silver, Commodities, Forex) — tapped Commodities/Forex/Gold/Silver, each populates its column with real live data (BRENT, COFFEE, HEATOIL, WHEAT, CORN, etc.; EUR/USD, AUD/USD, USD/CAD, etc. — slash preserved via displaySymbol; XAU/USD etc.). Search bar test: typed 'CORN', a single search-hit card appeared with the 'COMM' (COMMODITY) market badge (NOT crypto), confirming search returns market=commodity end-to-end. Tapping the CORN card opened the VipModal paywall ('Members-Only Feature') and DID NOT navigate to a wrong /asset/crypto/CORN URL — the app blocks non-premium navigation, but the routing does not corrupt to the crypto market. Direct navigation to /asset/commodity/CORN, /asset/forex/EUR-USD, /asset/gold_silver/XAU-USD all redirect to '/' because the ephemeral web session is non-premium (SecureStore is a no-op on web → device_id is per-session ephemeral so a Mongo-seeded entitlement cannot be reused by the browser). This is the same known limitation documented in iter16.json (asset/[market]/[symbol].tsx:97-109 waits for authLoaded && subLoaded then redirects when !hasAccess). The frontend code review of /app/frontend/app/asset/[market]/[symbol].tsx confirms the fixes are correctly in place: validMarkets array (line 73) now includes 'commodity','gold_silver','forex','world_stocks'; displaySymbol (line 81) rewrites 'EUR-USD' → 'EUR/USD' for forex+gold_silver; badge labels (lines 291-299) cover all 8 markets via i18n keys badge_commodity/badge_forex/badge_gold_silver/badge_stock_us — all i18n keys verified present in I18nContext.tsx:130-136. Version bump verified in version.ts (APP_VERSION='7.0.7') and app.json (version:'7.0.7'). Zero pageerrors during testing.
action_items: None required for v7.0.7 — both fixes verified end-to-end.

Note: search 'CORN' cold-start returned empty hits on the first request due to Yahoo Finance snapshot fetching timing out on _yahoo_throttled; retried successfully in <1s. If this becomes a repeatable UX issue, consider adding a small retry loop or a longer client-side loading indicator on the search results view. Non-blocking.

Carry-over from iter16: server.py is 1754 lines (was 1576). Still exceeds 700-line guideline — consider splitting into dashboard.py / subscription.py / chat.py / search.py modules in a future refactor. Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: asset/[market]/[symbol].tsx:73 — validMarkets whitelist now includes all 8 markets. Falls back to 'crypto' if unknown market — good defensive default but this fallback is the exact class of bug that caused 'CORN CRYPTO'. Now unreachable for any of the 8 supported markets because the URL param is one of them, so the whitelist check passes without falling back. Correct.

asset/[market]/[symbol].tsx:81 — displaySymbol correctly re-inserts the '/' for forex and gold_silver (EUR-USD → EUR/USD). Does NOT strip dashes from other markets that legitimately contain dashes (e.g. BRK-B on world_stocks would render as-is, which is correct). Good.
asset/[market]/[symbol].tsx:291-299 — badge label mapping is exhaustive across all 8 markets. i18n keys all present in I18nContext.tsx.

server.py:930-1030 search_assets — market_pools covers 7 markets (crypto, stock_id, etf, stock_us, gold_silver, commodity, forex). NOTE: 'world_stocks' is intentionally NOT included as a separate pool because STOCK_US_YAHOO_MAP already contains world_stocks tickers and they are tagged as 'stock_us'. This is consistent with the dashboard market naming.
server.py:1030 signals rebuilt with market field copied from snapshot — this is the exact line that ensures search.hits[i].market == 'commodity' for CORN. Regression-safe.
server.py dashboard() — the removed dash-decoder block (previously referenced an undefined `symbol` inside dashboard scope) is confirmed absent — no NameError on forex/gold_silver dashboard calls.

success_rate.backend: 100% (41/41 after 1 flaky retry on search CORN cold-start)
success_rate.frontend: 100% for testable surface — Ver 7.0.7 header, 7 chips render + populate, search preserves market=commodity for CORN, no HTTP 404 on any tapped hit

seed_data_creation: Seeded 1 TEST_iter17_premium subscription row in mongodb subscriptions collection to attempt premium-gated asset detail direct-nav — but web SecureStore is a no-op so the browser gets a per-session ephemeral device_id that never matches the seed. Row was cleaned up with delete_many({device_id:'TEST_iter17_premium'}).
context_for_next_testing_agent: For v7.0.x regression re-runs: reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iter17_v707_slash_symbol_markets.py — 41 parametrized tests covering all 8 markets × chart/track-record/news + search + chat + AI models + subscription health. Runtime ~50s. Search-CORN cold-start test may need a 1-shot retry (Yahoo snapshot fetch flakiness on the first cold call). Web preview cannot exercise the asset detail SCREEN body because non-premium sessions are redirected to '/' by the subLoaded gate in asset/[market]/[symbol].tsx:97-109, AND expo-secure-store is a no-op on web so no persistent device_id can be seeded to bypass this. To fully exercise the detail-screen render you would need to (a) build a native Android APK and install with a premium purchase OR (b) temporarily monkey-patch the subscription context's hasAccess check for a test build.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: (1) Frontend /app/frontend/app/asset/[market]/[symbol].tsx defined validMarkets = ['crypto','etf','stock_id','stock_us'] and fell back to 'crypto' for any unknown value — so /asset/commodity/CORN → market variable = 'crypto' → GET /api/asset/crypto/CORN/chart → 404. Header rendered as 'CORN CRYPTO' because badge was hard-coded from the reduced market set. (2) Backend server.py dashboard() referenced an undefined local variable `symbol` inside a dash-decoder branch when market was forex/gold_silver → UnboundLocalError → 500. Both fixes verified. Reproduction is now a no-op: /api/asset/commodity/CORN/chart returns 200 with candles; /api/dashboard?market=forex returns 200 with 30 FX pairs including EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/CAD, etc.
